messages:
Maria G.: Heads-up — marketplace is planning an auth header change (X-API-Key -> Authorization: Bearer) for the managed SDKs. Targeting rollout 2026-04-27. We need to coordinate with HW partners + SIs so vendor listings and on-prem packages don't break.
Thomas L.: 3-week validation window req from SIs. Their CI runs against vendor images take time. Staggering sounds necessary. Also need a compatibility shim for older integrations if possible.
Kai N.: Do we have a minimal shim design? Could be a proxy container that rewrites headers. Example proxy config we used before:
```yaml
- name: header-rewrite
  image: redwood/header-shim:stable
  env:
    - OLD_HEADER: X-API-Key
    - NEW_HEADER: Authorization
```
Maria G.: That proxy looks fine as a short term. Marketplace vendors can't run arbitrary sidecars though — need vendor approval. What are the approval SLA windows?
Partner Bot: Marketplace vendor update review typically takes 48-72 hours once the submission is complete. Security scans may add time.
Thomas L.: Ok. Timeline proposal: announce change to partners 2026-04-01, provide shim + SDK patch week of 2026-04-06, start vendor submissions 2026-04-13, live 2026-04-27. That gives ~2 weeks for vendor review + 1 week buffer.
Amanda C.: Need comms for joint announcement: public marketplace note, SI runbook, and a targeted email for hardware partners. I can draft the runbook if you assign me requirements.
Maria G.: Assigned to Amanda. Requirements: 1) how to detect old header usage 2) sample curl + SDK patch notes 3) rollback steps if auth starts failing for customers 4) compatibility proxy manifest and resource guidance.
Kai N.: For detection, add logging rule: if request lacks Authorization header but has X-API-Key, tag with metric partner.auth.legacy and emit alert if >1000/hr.
Thomas L.: We should also gate our SDK release on partner CI passing. Can we add a partner-run job in our CI that hits a sandbox vendor image?
Maria G.: Yes — we'll create a partner-sandbox pipeline token. @AnnounceBot please create a /vendor-sandbox channel and post the release draft.
AnnounceBot: Created #vendor-sandbox and posted draft comms: https://go.redwood.ai/partner-announce-draft
Amanda C.: I'll ping hardware partners on the 2026-04-01 notice and include the shim manifest, detection rule, and SDK patch notes. Also adding a note about the marketplace approval SLA.
Maria G.: Action items recap: Amanda — draft and send partner notice; Kai — produce shim manifest + detection snippet; Thomas — add partner-run job to CI and coordinate SI windows; I'll update the marketplace release request with the 48-72h review expectation. Follow-up sync in #vendor-sandbox Tue 09:30 PT. :thumbsup:
Thomas L.: Thanks — scheduling internal SI heads sync for Mon 14:00 PT. Will share test plans.
Amanda C.: Draft done, sharing in #vendor-sandbox now. :email:
Maria G.: Great. If partners need a longer runway we can push live date by up to 2 weeks, but try to keep customers informed. End of thread.
